description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horethuduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, identity card numbers, and land title classifications. The content is focused on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
